stemMd:
The new method allows the team to measure changes more ______ than before. Repeated trials show less variation when different researchers analyze the same sample.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The word describes how the team measures, so it must be an adverb. More consistently forms the correct comparison with than before.

distractorRationale.a: An adverb is needed to modify measure.
distractorRationale.b: The noun cannot modify the verb in this position.
distractorRationale.c: This adjective phrase does not complete the comparative adverb construction.
